creatures.name: Drowned Gull
creatures.about: A What Answers: gulls that drowned in the storm but still circle the tower, their throats full of seawater and hymns.
creatures.look: Bloated white feathers, milky eyes, and open mouths that click with the tide.

attacks.name: Gale Peck
attacks.effect: On a hit, the target is Shaken.

abilities.name: Tide Calling
abilities.effect: An investigator who hears it croak must pass a Listen roll against Regular Peril or lose 1 Sanity.

creatures.tactics: It swoops, pecks, and flees when hurt, returning to call other things out of the fog.

creatures.name: Tide Child
creatures.about: A What Answers: a child-shaped drowned thing that lures people toward cold water.
creatures.look: A small, wet figure in old clothes, with hair full of sand and a smile too wide for its face.

attacks.name: Cold Grip
attacks.effect: On a surge, the target is Frozen.

abilities.name: Ask to Be Held
abilities.effect: An investigator who fails a Resolve roll against Hard Peril when it reaches for them loses 1 Sanity.

creatures.tactics: It hides in fog and calls from shore, trying to separate one investigator from the rest.

creatures.name: Tide-Kin
creatures.about: A What Answers: drowned townsfolk whose bodies are pulled by the harbour's old voice.
creatures.look: Blue-lipped people in salt-stiff clothes, moving as if dragged by an unseen rope.

attacks.name: Drowned Claw
attacks.effect: On a surge, the target is Bleeding.

abilities.name: Chorus
abilities.effect: When it is with another What Answers, its attack rating is +10.

creatures.tactics: It lunges from surf or shadow, grabs an investigator, and tries to drag them toward the water.

creatures.name: Drowned Keeper's Wife
creatures.about: A What Answers: the lighthouse keeper's wife, still guarding the light she cannot leave.
creatures.look: A swollen woman in a wet dress, carrying a lantern that burns without oil.

attacks.name: Lantern Bite
attacks.effect: On a hit, the target is Shaken.

abilities.name: Lantern Lure
abilities.effect: An investigator who looks at her lantern must pass a Resolve roll against Hard Peril or lose 1 Sanity.

creatures.tactics: It stays near the lamp or stairs, striking when investigators try to pass or put out the light.

creatures.name: Drowned Keeper
creatures.about: A What Answers: the keeper, drowned but still tending a lamp no hand should keep lit.
creatures.look: A tall, waterlogged man with a hatchet and a face carved by salt and storm.

attacks.name: Storm Hatchet
attacks.effect: On a surge, the target is Bleeding.

abilities.name: Lamp Keeper
abilities.effect: While it stands in the tower, its defence is +5.

creatures.tactics: It blocks the stairway, swings old tools, and screams when anyone nears the lamp.

creatures.name: Singing Choir
creatures.about: A What Answers: many drowned mouths moved together, singing the harbour's old words.
creatures.look: A wet mass of bodies, faces, and hands sliding along the walls like one long creature.

attacks.name: Many Hands
attacks.effect: On a hit, the target is Exhausted.

abilities.name: Chant
abilities.effect: Any investigator who hears it must pass a Resolve roll against Hard Peril or lose 1 Sanity.

creatures.tactics: It surges in wet waves, grabs, and drowns. It falters if the rite is broken or the light is changed.

creatures.name: Harbour Worm
creatures.about: A What Answers: a pale thing that lives in the sea cave's tidal mud.
creatures.look: A ringed, eyeless body the width of a man, with a mouth like a broken lamp.

attacks.name: Mud Lash
attacks.effect: On a surge, the target is Bleeding.

abilities.name: Cave Ambush
abilities.effect: If investigators fail a Stealth roll in the sea cave, it is hidden until it attacks.

creatures.tactics: It waits in wet dark, pulls legs, and drags victims into the tidal muck.

creatures.name: Choir Master
creatures.about: A What Answers: the drowned cult leader who sings the old thing awake from beneath the harbour.
creatures.look: A bloated priest-shape in torn robes, eyes open, mouth moving with a voice that fills the cave.

attacks.name: Salt Staff
attacks.effect: On a surge, the target is Bleeding.

abilities.name: Rite Leader
abilities.effect: While the rite is underway, all What Answers gain +10 to attack ratings.

abilities.name: Deep Song
abilities.effect: An investigator who hears it sing must pass a Resolve roll against Dire Peril or lose 1 Sanity.

creatures.tactics: It keeps the centre of the rite, uses the choir as a shield, and flees to deeper water if the rite fails.

creatures.name: Gull Rock Thing
creatures.about: The old sleeper beneath the harbour, stirring when the tide and rite fill the dark.
creatures.look: A hill of wet stone that is not stone, with mouths opening where the waves strike.

attacks.name: Tentacle
attacks.effect: On a hit, the target is Shaken.

abilities.name: Harbour Dream
abilities.effect: An investigator who sees it must pass a Resolve roll against Dire Peril or lose 2 Sanity.

creatures.tactics: It is not meant for a fair fight. It stirs when the rite nears completion or the light is wrong, punishing those who try to wake or silence it.
